$comment: TRANSCRIBED from toolbox/config_swap_probe/config_swap_probe_keys.h + _io.h. config_swap_probe is a reference SOURCE for the orchestrator config-swap design: its process() has no data contract, so its surface is its CONFIG ({value}), one exchange COMMAND (get_status), and the STATUS object that command returns. That status object is declared under "replies" — the reply-extractor family (polaris2 codegen gap #2): each reply class is a typed reader over an exchange() reply string (xi::Json::parse + as_* getters + valid()). The proc counter is number-carried on the wire and read back as long long via the whitelisted "cast" (the one bespoke read). Reply field keys are minted into _keys.gen.h exactly like the old "outputs" listing was; a source's replies never become schema slots or TS/Py types.
title: config_swap_probe — orchestrator config-swap reference (config + get_status).
